items.claim: Transform preview of extension-changed nodes differs from the commit
items.note: The preview is now read off the same `otherOps` the commit writes, through `writtenBy`, so data-only changes and the stripped generator/geometry data show during the drag. It also now uses the `data` that earlier followers previewed, which it used to ignore.

items.claim: Held `editAnchors` dep's setters use the editing id and state captured at read
items.note: Every setter, `setHandleLocks` included, now reads `stateRef.current` and its editing id at call time.

items.claim: `insertSite` keeps a node on its page only when the parent is the page node itself
items.note: With the pasteboard off, a node inserted into a container on a page is now kept partly on it, because the code takes the page `pageIdOf` finds by walking up the parent's ancestors. `pasteOnPages` only ever resolves page nodes, so it doesn't have the same problem.

The dep is now absent while the ref holds no resolver. `contextMenu`'s `requires: ['kindOfNode']` only names the dep (`createActionDeps` doesn't gate on it being there), and it reads the dep with `?.`, so nothing breaks.
